name: Route Leg
description: A line draws itself between two places on a map, with a pin and name at each end; full frame or a corner card.

controls.name: Map
controls.description: The map picture, drawn by tools/maps.py route-legs at the frame size.

controls.name: From Position
controls.description: Start pin, in the map picture's pixels.

controls.name: To Position
controls.description: End pin, in the map picture's pixels.

controls.name: Curve
controls.description: How far the line bows from straight: 50 is straight, 70 bows it by 20 % of its length, 35 by 15 % the other way.

controls.name: Corner Inset
controls.description: Show the map as a card in the top-right corner over transparency.

controls.name: Map Credit
controls.description: Shown in the map's bottom-right corner; maps.py fills "© OpenStreetMap" when the map uses OpenStreetMap data.

controls.name: Texture
controls.description: Optional paper or grain picture, multiplied over the map (white changes nothing).

controls.name: Name Font
controls.description: Any installed font, for both names (they always match).

controls.name: Credit Font
controls.description: Any installed font, for the map credit.

credits: Natural Earth (public domain) for the default maps
© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL, when a map includes OpenStreetMap detail
